provenance.equation: The printed dimensionless equations are dR/dt'=Delta/pi+2*R*v and dv/dt'=v^2+eta_bar+J*R+I-(pi*R)^2.
provenance.change_of_variables: R=tau*r and t'=t/tau, so dR/dt'=tau^2*dr/dt and dv/dt'=tau*dv/dt
provenance.timestep_note: The paper specifies continuous ordinary differential equations. The 0.01 explicit-Euler step is the maintained deterministic implementation contract, not a paper requirement.
provenance.input_note: The bounded deterministic sinusoidal drive is a reproducible parity protocol, not a reproduction of a paper figure.
provenance.identity_note: The legacy public class name does not imply Ermentrout-Kopell 1986 dynamics; the maintained flow is the recorded variable restoration of Montbrio-Pazo-Roxin 2015 equations (12a-b).
